svg.text: Astrokarma Project Structure & Domain Model Architecture
Entity-Relationship & Service Interactions Organised by Django Apps (Clean Modular Architecture)

g.text: 🔒 Unique constraint on (session_id, minute_number) guarantees idempotency
Each billed minute maps directly to one immutable Debit WalletTransaction record.
• Raised when wallet < 5x rate to start call
• Raised on illegal session state jumps
• Standardises error response format across apps
Consultation logic never mutates wallet balances
directly via SQL; it delegates strictly to WalletService.
Every minute billed creates a SessionBillingRecord
and an immutable WalletTransaction audit record.
apps/common catches business errors and serializes
them into uniform JSON format with proper HTTP codes.
